powertrains.transmission: Automatic transmission (Genuine NISSAN Matic P ATF)

maintenance_items.notes: Perform at number of miles, kilometers or months, whichever comes first.

First at 10,000/12mo (severe essentials). Standard schedule shows at 30,000/24mo, 60,000/48mo, 90,000/72mo. Severe schedule shows at 10,000, 20,000, 30,000, 40,000, 50,000, 60,000, 70,000, 80,000, 90,000, 110,000. Pattern is approximately every 20,000 miles standard, every 10,000 miles severe after first service.

Appears at nearly every severe interval (every 5,000 miles) and at many standard intervals. Listed as an essential at 10,000; 15,000(severe); 20,000; 25,000; 30,000; 35,000; 40,000; 45,000(severe); 50,000; 55,000; 60,000; 65,000; 67,500(standard); 70,000; 75,000(severe); 80,000; 85,000; 90,000; 95,000; 110,000; 112,500(standard) per schedule.
Replace at 15,000/12mo, 30,000/24mo, 45,000/36mo, 60,000/48mo, 75,000/60mo, 90,000/72mo per schedule. Replace more frequently when driving in dusty conditions.
Inspect at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000 miles. Request dealer to inspect fluid deterioration data using CONSULT. If deterioration data is more than 77000, replace the AT fluid.

Replace at 30,000/24mo, 60,000/48mo, 90,000/72mo under severe use. Also per chassis/body maintenance section: replace every 30,000 miles (48,000 km) or 24 months if towing a trailer, using a camper or car-top carrier, or driving on rough or muddy roads.

Standard schedule shows replace at 20,000; 40,000; 60,000; 80,000 miles. Also per chassis/body maintenance: replace every 20,000 miles (32,000 km) or 24 months if towing a trailer, using a camper or car-top carrier, or driving on rough or muddy roads.
Replace at 20,000; 40,000; 60,000; 80,000 miles per schedule.
Replace at 30,000; 60,000; 90,000 miles per standard schedule. If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.
Replace at 45,000/36mo, 67,500/54mo, 90,000/72mo, 112,500/90mo per schedule.

Life expectancy of factory-fill coolant is 105,000 miles (168,000 km) or 7 years. Use only Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. Mixing other coolant types or non-distilled water may reduce the service interval.

Inspect at every standard service interval. Check for wear, fraying, cracking and proper tension. Replace any damaged drive belts. Items marked * are recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation.
Inspect at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000 miles per standard schedule.
Inspect at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000 miles per standard schedule.
Inspect at 30,000; 60,000; 90,000 miles. Marked * — recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; owner need not perform to maintain emission warranty.
Inspect at 30,000; 60,000; 90,000 miles. Marked * — recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; owner need not perform to maintain emission warranty.
Inspect at every standard service interval. Check for damage, looseness, and grease leakage.

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent); synthetic 0W-20 GF-6 SP may be used if above not available. Must meet API certification or ILSAC certification and SAE viscosity standard.
fluids.capacity: 6-7/8 qt with oil filter change; 6-1/2 qt without oil filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent; 50% antifreeze / 50% water mixture; antifreeze protection to -34°F (-37°C)
fluids.capacity: 3-1/2 gal (Non-XD model, with reservoir); 3-1/2 gal (XD model, with reservoir)

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Matic P ATF or equivalent. Do not mix with other fluids.
Genuine NISSAN Differential Oil Synthetic GL-5 75W-85. Do not mix with other fluids.
Genuine NISSAN Differential Oil Synthetic GL-5 75W-85. Do not mix with other fluids.

Unleaded premium gasoline, octane rating at least 91 AKI (RON 96) recommended. Unleaded regular 87 AKI (RON 91) may be used with possible decrease in performance. No E-15 or E-85. No leaded gasoline. No MMT-containing fuel.

oil_life_monitor: No oil life monitor described in the provided pages. Oil and filter replacement is on a fixed mileage/time interval (every 7,500 miles or 6 months, whichever comes first).
extraction_caveats: 1. Pages 564–565 (covering approximately 105,000–107,500 mile intervals) were not provided; the engine coolant replacement interval of 105,000 miles/7 years is sourced from the coolant description on p.494 and p.542, not from a schedule page. 2. The severe-use intervals for brake fluid, differential oil, and transfer case oil replacement follow the pattern visible in the schedule. Brake fluid appears at 10k, 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 110k. Differential and transfer case oil at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k. 3. Transfer case oil specification was not explicitly listed in the fluids table on p.572; no separate spec was provided in the extracted pages. 4. The Intelligent Key battery is inspected at 22,500/18mo and replaced at 45,000/36mo, 67,500/54mo, 90,000/72mo, and 112,500/90mo. 5. The brake fluid first service at 10,000 miles appears under severe essentials on p.545; standard schedule first shows brake fluid replacement at 30,000 miles on p.549. 6. Pages covering 100,000–112,500 mile range were partially provided (p.563, p.566); page 564–565 content was absent. 7. The differential gear oil capacities on p.572 show Front: 2-5/8 pt (Non-XD) / 3-1/4 pt (XD) and Rear: 4-7/8 pt (Non-XD) / 5-1/2 pt (XD).
